adjudication.rationale: Looking at lines 1053-1058 in handleNewBooking.ts, the code sets `destinationCalendar` to `[eventType.destinationCalendar]` if it exists, else `[organizerUser.destinationCalendar]` if it exists, else `null`. Then at lines 1065-1067, it only pushes `teamDestinationCalendars` if `evt.destinationCalendar` exists (using optional chaining `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...)`). If the organizer has no destination calendar, `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`, and the push operation on null does nothing (it's a no-op with optional chaining), so all collected team member destination calendars are silently discarded. This is a real bug where collective team events with an organizer lacking a destination calendar will lose all cohost calendars.
